prompts.prompt: Name the snack your partner would choose for the perfect movie night, then let them reveal the real answer.
Share one small thing your partner did this week that made life easier.
Choose a song for a thirty-second seated dance break, or simply listen to the chorus together.
Predict which destination your partner would book for a surprise weekend away.
Tell the story of a date that became funny because something did not go as planned.
Point at the person most likely to fall asleep during a movie, then defend your choice kindly.
Give your partner a sincere compliment they have not heard from you this week.
Choose between breakfast in bed and a late-night dessert run, then compare answers.
Describe your partner's ideal lazy Sunday in three details.
Pick a harmless household task for a ten-second mime while your partner guesses it.
Name one meal you would happily learn to cook together.
Share the first tiny detail you remember noticing about your partner.
Choose one photo from your relationship you would print and keep on a desk.
Predict which fictional world your partner would visit for one day.
Make up a two-line slogan for your relationship and read it with dramatic confidence.
Name a simple tradition you want to repeat next month.
Choose the road-trip role your partner fits best: navigator, DJ, snack manager, or storyteller.
Share one opinion you changed after listening to your partner.
Guess the comfort food your partner would order after a long day.
Give your partner a five-second acceptance speech for being excellent at one everyday skill.
Name a hobby you would try together if equipment and lessons were free.
Choose one season for your next couple trip and explain the first activity you would plan.
Tell your partner which of their expressions always makes you smile.
Predict the first item your partner would buy with an unexpected fifty dollars.
Create a secret handshake with only two moves, or choose a fist bump as the alcohol-free action.
Name one place close to home that deserves a future mini-date.
Share a harmless habit you have copied from your partner.
Choose a dessert to split and decide who gets the last bite.
Describe one ordinary moment together that you would happily replay.
Finish the round by choosing your next small date: a walk, a game, a café, or a meal at home.
